note: Final (held-out) study plan, declared before the protocol freeze and hashed into it. Phases run in order; every phase runs scenario by scenario and writes a per-scenario checkpoint. Arms: single and graph, each scored before and after the verifier (single, single+verifier, graph, graph+verifier). The model, temperature (0), budgets, prompts and retrieval mode are those of study.json / the code at the freeze. With temperature 0 the repeats measure run-to-run nondeterminism of the local runtime, not sampling variance.
